title.zh: 卷三 本紀第三 高宗
title.raw: 卷三 本紀第三 高宗 Volume 3 Annals 3: Gaozong

sentences.zh: 高宗天皇大聖大弘孝皇帝諱治，字為善，太宗第九子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong Tian Huang Great Sage Great Broad Filial, taboo name Zhi, courtesy name Weishan, was Taizong's ninth son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong, posthumously honored as Tian Huang the Great Sage and Great Broadly Filial, bore the taboo name Zhi and the courtesy name Weishan. He was Taizong's ninth son.

sentences.zh: 母曰文德皇后長孫氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Wende, née Changsun.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Wende of the Changsun clan.

sentences.zh: 始封晉王，貞觀七年，遙領并州都督。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Jin; in the seventh year of Zhenguan he remotely held the post of protector-general of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Jin. In the seventh year of Zhenguan he remotely held the post of protector-general of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年，太子承乾廢，而魏王泰次當立，亦以罪黜，乃立子治為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Crown Prince Chengqian was deposed; Prince of Wei Tai was next in line for enthronement, but he too was dismissed for crime, whereupon Taizong's son Zhi was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Crown Prince Chengqian was deposed. Prince of Wei Tai stood next in line to succeed, but he too was dismissed for his crimes, and Taizong thereupon established his son Li Zhi as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘗命皇太子遊觀習射，太子辭以非所好，願得奉至尊，居膝下。

translations.literal: Taizong once ordered the crown prince to tour, observe, and practice archery; the crown prince declined on the grounds that it was not to his liking, saying he wished to serve the Supreme One and dwell at his knee.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong once ordered the crown prince to tour the grounds and practice archery. The crown prince declined, saying it was not to his liking and that he wished instead to attend the emperor and remain at his side.

sentences.zh: 太宗大喜，乃營寢殿側為別院，使太子居之。

translations.literal: Taizong was greatly pleased and thereupon built a separate residence beside the sleeping hall, making the crown prince dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was greatly pleased and had a separate residence built beside the imperial bedchamber for the crown prince to live in.

sentences.zh: 太宗每視朝，皇太子常侍，觀決庶政。

translations.literal: Whenever Taizong held court, the crown prince regularly attended in service, observing and deciding ordinary governance.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Taizong held court, the crown prince regularly attended and observed the handling of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，太宗有疾，詔皇太子聽政於金液門。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Taizong fell ill and decreed that the crown prince should attend to governance at the Gate of Golden Liquid.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Taizong fell ill and decreed that the crown prince should attend to governance at the Gate of Golden Liquid.

sentences.zh: 四月，從幸翠微宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, he accompanied him on a visit to Cuiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he accompanied Taizong on a visit to Cuiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 太宗崩，以羽檄發六府甲士四千，衛皇太子入于京師。

translations.literal: When Taizong died, by urgent dispatch four thousand armored soldiers of the six guard commands were mobilized to escort the crown prince into the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong died, an urgent dispatch mobilized four thousand armored soldiers from the six guard commands to escort the crown prince into the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，即皇帝位于柩前。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the sixth month, he assumed the imperial throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the sixth month he ascended the throne before Taizong's coffin.

sentences.zh: 大赦，賜文武官勳一轉，民八十以上粟帛，給復雍州及比歲供軍所一年。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were granted one degree of merit; commoners eighty years and above were granted grain and silk; Yongzhou and places that had supplied armies in recent years were granted one year of tax and corvée exemption.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty, granted civil and military officials one degree of merit, and awarded grain and silk to commoners aged eighty and above. Yongzhou and districts that had supplied armies in recent years were granted one year of tax and corvée exemption.

sentences.zh: 癸未，長孫無忌為太尉。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Zhangsun Wuji was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei Zhangsun Wuji was appointed Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，檢校洛州刺史李勣為開府儀同三司，參掌機密。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Li Ji, acting prefect of Luozhou, was made Director with Ceremonial Parity to the Third Rank and shared in handling confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi Li Ji, acting prefect of Luozhou, was appointed director with ceremonial parity to the third rank and shared in handling confidential state affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，河東地震。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the eighth month, Hedong was struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the eighth month an earthquake struck Hedong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，又震。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai it shook again.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣使存問河東，給復二年，賜壓死者人絹三匹。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, envoys were sent to inquire after Hedong; two years of tax and corvée exemption were granted, and three bolts of silk were granted per person crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen he sent envoys to inquire after Hedong, granted two years of tax and corvée exemption, and awarded three bolts of silk for each person crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，葬文皇帝于昭陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Emperor Wen was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin Taizong was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，荊王元景為司徒，吳王恪為司空。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the ninth month, Prince of Jing Yuanjing was made Minister of Education; Prince of Wu Ke was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the ninth month Yuanjing, Prince of Jing, was appointed Minister of Education and Ke, Prince of Wu, was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，李勣為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Li Ji was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao Li Ji was appointed left vice director of the Department of State and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，晉州地震。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the eleventh month, Jinzhou was struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the eleventh month an earthquake struck Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 左翊衛郎將高侃伐突厥。

translations.literal: Left Wing Guard commandant Gao Kan campaigned against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Left Wing Guard commandant Gao Kan campaigned against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無雪。

translations.literal: That winter, there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 二年正月戊戌，開義倉以賑民。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the day wuxu in the first month, the charity granaries were opened to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the day wuxu in the first month, he opened the charity granaries to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，黃門侍郎宇文節、中書侍郎柳奭同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Secretaries of the Yellow Gate Yuwen Jie and Secretary of the Secretariat Liu Shi were made associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi Yuwen Jie, secretary of the yellow gate, and Liu Shi, secretary of the secretariat, were appointed associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，瑤池都督阿史那賀魯叛。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Protector-general of Yaochi Ashina Helu rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao Ashina Helu, protector-general of Yaochi, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，命有司毋進肉食，訖于五月。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the fourth month, the responsible offices were ordered not to present meat foods, continuing until the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the fourth month he ordered the responsible offices to stop presenting meat dishes, a prohibition lasting through the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 七月丁未，賀魯寇庭州，左武衛大將軍梁建方、右驍衛大將軍契苾何力為弓月道行軍總管以伐之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the seventh month, Helu raided Tingzhou; Left Martial Guard Grand General Liang Jianfang and Right Swift Cavalry Guard Grand General Qibi Heli were made campaign generals of the Gongyue Route to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei in the seventh month Helu raided Tingzhou. Liang Jianfang, grand general of the Left Martial Guard, and Qibi Heli, grand general of the Right Swift Cavalry Guard, were appointed campaign generals of the Gongyue Route to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，高季輔為侍中；

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the eighth month, Gao Jifu was made Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the eighth month Gao Jifu was appointed palace attendant;

sentences.zh: 于志寧為尚書左僕射，張行成為右僕射，同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Yu Zhining was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State; Zhang Xingcheng was made Right Vice Director, both associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zhining was appointed left vice director of the Department of State, and Zhang Xingcheng was appointed right vice director, both as associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 己卯，白水蠻寇邊，左領軍將軍趙孝祖為郎州道行軍總管以伐之。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the Baishui barbarians raided the border; Left Army General Zhao Xiaozu was made campaign general of the Langzhou Route to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao the Baishui barbarians raided the frontier. Zhao Xiaozu, general of the Left Army, was appointed campaign general of the Langzhou Route to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，以同州苦泉牧地賜貧民。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the ninth month, Kuchuan pasture lands of Tongzhou were granted to poor commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the ninth month he granted the Kuchuan pasture lands of Tongzhou to poor commoners.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，晉州地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the tenth month, Jinzhou was struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao in the tenth month an earthquake struck Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the eleventh month, the suburban sacrifice was performed at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the eleventh month he performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，禁進犬馬鷹鶻。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the presentation of dogs, horses, hawks, and falcons was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou he forbade the presentation of dogs, horses, hawks, and falcons.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，忻州地震。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Xinzhou was struck by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin an earthquake struck Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雨木冰。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, rain froze on trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen sleet fell.

sentences.zh: 是月，竇州、義州蠻寇邊，桂州都督劉伯英敗之。

translations.literal: That month, barbarians of Douzhou and Yizhou raided the border; Protector-general of Guizhou Liu Boying defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That month barbarians of Dou and Yi prefectures raided the frontier, and Liu Boying, protector-general of Guizhou, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 趙孝祖及白水蠻戰于羅仵候山，敗之。

translations.literal: Zhao Xiaozu fought the Baishui barbarians at Mount Luowuhou and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiaozu fought the Baishui barbarians at Mount Luowuhou and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the twelfth month, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei in the twelfth month Venus was visible in daytime.

sentences.zh: 壬子，處月朱邪孤注殺招慰使單道惠，叛附于賀魯。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Zhuye Guzhu of the Chueyue killed the pacification commissioner Shan Daohui and rebelled to join Helu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi Zhuye Guzhu of the Chueyue killed pacification commissioner Shan Daohui and rebelled to join Helu.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無雪。

translations.literal: That winter, there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 五年正月丙寅，以旱詔文武官、朝集使言事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on the day bingyin in the first month, because of drought civil and military officials and assembly envoys were ordered to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the day bingyin in the first month, because of drought he ordered civil and military officials and assembly envoys to submit memorials on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，如萬年宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the third month, he went to Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the third month he went to Wannian Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，次鳳泉湯。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, he stopped at Fengquan Hot Springs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou he stopped at Fengquan Hot Springs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，赦岐州及所過徒罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Qizhou and places he passed through were granted amnesty for penal servitude and lesser crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei he granted amnesty in Qizhou and along his route for penal servitude and lesser offenses.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，柳奭罷。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the sixth month, Liu Shi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai in the sixth month Liu Shi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河北大水，遣使慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Hebei suffered great flooding; envoys were sent to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin severe flooding struck Hebei, and he sent envoys to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，詔免麟游、岐陽今歲課役，岐州及供頓縣半歲。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the eighth month, an edict exempted Linyou and Qiyang from this year's taxes and corvée, and Qizhou and supply-station counties from half a year's.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei in the eighth month he decreed exemption from this year's taxes and corvée for Linyou and Qiyang, and half a year's exemption for Qizhou and the counties that served as supply stations.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，至自萬年宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the ninth month, he returned from Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the ninth month he returned from Wannian Palace.

sentences.zh: 十月癸卯，築京師羅郭，起觀于九門。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the tenth month, the encircling outer walls of the capital were built and lookout towers were erected at the nine gates.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the tenth month he built the encircling outer walls of the capital and erected lookout towers at the nine gates.

sentences.zh: 六年正月壬申，拜昭陵，赦醴泉及行從，免縣今歲租、調，陵所宿衛進爵一級，令、丞加一階。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on the day renshen in the first month, he paid homage at Zhaoling; Liquan and his entourage were granted amnesty; the county was exempted from this year's land tax and labor allocation; garrison guards at the tomb were promoted one noble rank; the magistrate and assistant were raised one grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the day renshen in the first month, he paid homage at Zhaoling, granted amnesty to Liquan and his entourage, and exempted the county from this year's land tax and labor allocation. Garrison guards at the tomb were promoted one noble rank, and the magistrate and assistant were each raised one grade.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以少牢祭陪葬者。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, those buried in attendance were sacrificed to with the secondary offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou he sacrificed to those buried in attendance with the secondary offering of ox and sheep.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至自昭陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he returned from Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu he returned from Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，封子弘為代王，賢潞王。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, his son Hong was enfeoffed as Prince of Dai and Xian as Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin he enfeoffed his son Hong as Prince of Dai and Xian as Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，皇太子加元服，降死罪以下，賜酺三日，五品以上為父後者勳一轉。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the second month, the crown prince received the capping ceremony; sentences below capital punishment were reduced; festive drinking was granted for three days; officials of fifth rank and above who served as successors to their fathers were granted one degree of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the second month the crown prince received the capping ceremony. Sentences below capital punishment were commuted, festive drinking was granted for three days, and officials of fifth rank and above who served as successors to their fathers were granted one degree of merit.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，營州都督程名振、左衛中郎將蘇定方伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Protector-general of Yingzhou Cheng Mingzhen and Mid-grade General of the Left Guard Su Dingfang campaigned against Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou Cheng Mingzhen, protector-general of Yingzhou, and Su Dingfang, mid-grade general of the Left Guard, campaigned against Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，及高麗戰于貴端水，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the fifth month, they fought Goguryeo at Guiduan River and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the fifth month they fought Goguryeo at Guiduan River and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 癸未，左屯衛大將軍程知節為葱山道行軍大總管，以伐賀魯。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Left Garrison Guard Grand General Cheng Zhijie was made grand campaign general of the Congshan Route to campaign against Helu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei Cheng Zhijie, grand general of the Left Garrison Guard, was appointed grand campaign general of the Congshan Route to campaign against Helu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，韓瑗為侍中，來濟為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Han Yuan was made Palace Attendant; Lai Ji was made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen Han Yuan was appointed palace attendant and Lai Ji was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 七月乙酉，崔敦禮為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the seventh month, Cui Dunli was made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the seventh month Cui Dunli was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 是月，中書舍人李義府為中書侍郎，參知政事。

translations.literal: That month, Secretariat Drafting Officer Li Yifu was made Secretary of the Secretariat and joined in governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Yifu, secretariat drafter, was appointed secretary of the secretariat and joined in governing affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，貶褚遂良為潭州都督。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the ninth month, Chu Suiliang was demoted to protector-general of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu in the ninth month Chu Suiliang was demoted to protector-general of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，洛水溢。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou the Luo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 十月，齊州黃河溢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Yellow River overflowed at Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Yellow River overflowed in Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，廢皇后為庶人。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the empress was deposed and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou he deposed the empress and reduced her to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，立宸妃武氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Imperial Consort Wu was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao he established Imperial Consort Wu as empress.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大赦，賜民八十以上粟帛。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, a general amnesty was proclaimed; commoners eighty years and above were granted grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi he proclaimed a general amnesty and granted grain and silk to commoners aged eighty and above.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，皇后見于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the eleventh month, the empress was presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the eleventh month the empress was presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，停諸州貢珠。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, tribute of pearls from all prefectures was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi he halted the tribute of pearls from all prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔禁吏酷法及為隱名書者。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, an edict forbade officials' cruel laws and the writing of anonymous accusatory letters.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi he decreed a ban on cruel punishments by officials and on anonymous denunciations.

sentences.zh: 是冬，皇后殺王庶人。

translations.literal: That winter, the empress killed Former Consort Wang.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the empress had Lady Wang the commoner killed.

sentences.zh: 二年閏正月壬寅，如洛陽宮。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the day renyin in the intercalary first month, he went to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the day renyin in the intercalary first month, he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，右屯衛將軍蘇定方為伊麗道行軍總管，以伐賀魯。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Right Garrison Guard General Su Dingfang was made campaign general of the Yili Route to campaign against Helu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Su Dingfang, general of the Right Garrison Guard, was appointed campaign general of the Yili Route to campaign against Helu.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，降洛州囚罪，徒以下原之，免民一歲租、調，賜百歲以上氊衾粟帛。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the second month, Luozhou prisoners' sentences were reduced; penal servitude and lesser were pardoned; commoners were exempted one year's land tax and labor allocation; those one hundred years and above were granted felt, quilts, grain, and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai in the second month he reduced sentences for Luozhou prisoners, pardoned penal servitude and lesser offenses, exempted commoners from one year's land tax and labor allocation, and granted felt, quilts, grain, and silk to those aged one hundred and above.

sentences.zh: 庚午，封子顯為周王。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, his son Xian was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu he enfeoffed his son Xian as Prince of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，徙封素節為郇王。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Su Jie was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen Su Jie was transferred in rank to Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，禁舅姑拜公主，父母拜王妃。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the third month, parents-in-law bowing to princesses and parents bowing to imperial daughters-in-law were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the third month he forbade parents-in-law from bowing to princesses and parents from bowing to imperial daughters-in-law.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，李義府兼中書令。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Li Yifu was made concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou Li Yifu was appointed concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，幸明德宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the fifth month, he visited Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen in the fifth month he visited Mingde Palace.

sentences.zh: 七月丁亥，如洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the seventh month, he went to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the seventh month he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，貶韓瑗為振州刺史，來濟為台州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the eighth month, Han Yuan was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou; Lai Ji was demoted to prefect of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the eighth month Han Yuan was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou and Lai Ji was demoted to prefect of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，衛尉卿許敬宗為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Minister of the Court of Imperial Stud Xu Jingzong was made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Xu Jingzong, minister of the Court of Imperial Stud, was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，杜正倫兼中書令。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the ninth month, Du Zhenlun was made concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the ninth month Du Zhenlun was appointed concurrent secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，如許州。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the eleventh month, he went to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the eleventh month he went to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣使慮所過州縣囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, envoys were sent to review prisoners in the prefectures and counties he passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen he sent envoys to review prisoners in the prefectures and counties along his route.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，獵于滍南。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, he hunted south of the Zhi River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi he hunted south of the Zhi River.

sentences.zh: 壬子，講武于新鄭，赦鄭州，免一歲租賦，賜八十以上粟帛，其嘗事高祖任佐史者以名聞。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, he conducted military exercises at Xinzheng; Zhengzhou was granted amnesty; one year's land tax and levies were exempted; those eighty years and above were granted grain and silk; those who had once served Gaozu as clerks were to have their names reported.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi he conducted a military review at Xinzheng, granted amnesty to Zhengzhou, exempted the populace from one year's land tax and levies, and granted grain and silk to those aged eighty and above. Those who had once served as clerks under Gaozu were to have their names reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，如洛陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the twelfth month, he went to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao in the twelfth month he went to Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，蘇定方敗賀魯于金牙山，執之。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Su Dingfang defeated Helu at Mount Jinya and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi Su Dingfang defeated Helu at Mount Jinya and captured him.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以洛陽宮為東都。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Luoyang Palace was made the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao he designated Luoyang Palace as the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 三年正月戊申，楊冑及龜茲羯獵顛戰于泥師城，敗之。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the day wushen in the first month, Yang Zhou fought the Kuchan chieftain Jieliedian at Nishi Fort and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the day wushen in the first month, Yang Zhou fought the Kuchan chieftain Jieliedian at Nishi Fort and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 二月甲狾，至自東都。

translations.literal: On the day jia 狾 in the second month, he returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the second month he returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，程名振及高麗戰于赤烽鎮，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the sixth month, Cheng Mingzhen fought Goguryeo at Chifeng Fort and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the sixth month Cheng Mingzhen fought Goguryeo at Chifeng Fort and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，貶杜正倫為橫州刺史，李義府普州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the eleventh month, Du Zhenlun was demoted to prefect of Hengzhou; Li Yifu to prefect of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the eleventh month Du Zhenlun was demoted to prefect of Hengzhou and Li Yifu to prefect of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，許敬宗權檢校中書令。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Xu Jingzong provisionally supervised the Secretariat as acting director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi Xu Jingzong was appointed acting supervisor of the secretariat directorate.

sentences.zh: 甲午，蘇定方俘賀魯以獻。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Su Dingfang presented the captured Helu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Su Dingfang presented the captured Helu as tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，許敬宗為中書令，大理卿辛茂將兼侍中。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Xu Jingzong was made Secretariat Director; Chief Minister of Justice Xin Maojiang was made concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu Xu Jingzong was appointed secretariat director, and Xin Maojiang, chief minister of justice, was appointed concurrent palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 四年三月壬午，崑陵都護阿史那彌射及西突厥真珠葉護戰于雙河，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on the day renwu in the third month, Protector Ashina Mishe of Kunling and the Western Turk Yabghu True Pearl fought at Shuanghe and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the day renwu in the third month, Ashina Mishe, protector of Kunling, fought the Western Turk yabghu True Pearl at Shuanghe and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，于志寧為太子太師、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the fourth month, Yu Zhining was made Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the fourth month Yu Zhining was appointed grand preceptor to the crown prince and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，黃門侍郎許圉師同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Secretary of the Yellow Gate Xu Tushi was made associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou Xu Tushi, secretary of the yellow gate, was appointed associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，流長孫無忌于黔州。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Zhangsun Wuji was exiled to Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen Zhangsun Wuji was exiled to Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 于志寧罷。

translations.literal: Yu Zhining was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zhining was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，許圉師為中書侍郎、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the fifth month, Xu Tushi was made Secretary of the Secretariat and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the fifth month Xu Tushi was appointed secretary of the secretariat and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 丙申，兵部尚書任雅相、度支尚書盧承慶參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Minister of War Ren Yaxiang and Minister of Revenue Lu Chengqing joined in governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen Ren Yaxiang, minister of war, and Lu Chengqing, minister of revenue, joined in governing affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，殺涼州都督長史趙持滿。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Zhao Chiman, chief secretary of the protector-general of Liangzhou, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu Zhao Chiman, chief secretary to the protector-general of Liangzhou, was executed.

sentences.zh: 七月己丑，以旱避正殿。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the seventh month, due to drought he avoided the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou in the seventh month, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，李義府為吏部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the eighth month, Li Yifu was made Minister of Personnel and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the eighth month Li Yifu was appointed minister of personnel and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，皇太子加元服，大赦，賜五品以上子孫為父祖後者勳一轉，民酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the tenth month, the crown prince received the capping ceremony; a general amnesty was proclaimed; descendants of officials fifth rank and above who served as successors to fathers and grandfathers were granted one degree of merit; festive drinking was granted to the people for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the tenth month the crown prince received the capping ceremony. A general amnesty was proclaimed, descendants of officials fifth rank and above who served as successors to their fathers and grandfathers were granted one degree of merit, and the people were granted three days of festive drinking.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊寅，如東都，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the intercalary month, he went to the Eastern Capital; the crown prince supervised the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the intercalary month he went to the Eastern Capital, and the crown prince supervised state affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔所過供頓免今歲租賦之半，賜民八十以上氊衾粟帛。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, an edict granted the supply stations he passed through exemption of half this year's land tax and levies, and granted felt quilts, grain, and silk to commoners eighty years and above.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi he decreed that the supply stations along his route would be exempted from half this year's land tax and levies, and granted felt quilts, grain, and silk to commoners aged eighty and above.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，許圉師為左散騎常侍、檢校侍中。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the eleventh month, Xu Tushi was made Left Regular Companion of the Dissemination Horse and acting Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the eleventh month Xu Tushi was appointed left regular companion of the dissemination horse and acting palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊午，辛茂將薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Xin Maojiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu Xin Maojiang died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賀魯部悉結闕俟斤都曼寇邊，左驍衛大將軍蘇定方為安撫大使以伐之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Duman, yabghu of the Xijie clan of Helu's tribe, raided the border; Left Swift Cavalry Guard Grand General Su Dingfang was made pacification commissioner to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai Duman, yabghu of the Xijie clan of Helu's tribe, raided the frontier. Su Dingfang, grand general of the Left Swift Cavalry Guard, was appointed pacification commissioner to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 盧承慶同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Lu Chengqing was made associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chengqing was appointed associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 五年正月癸卯，蘇定方俘都曼以獻。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on the day guimao in the first month, Su Dingfang presented the captured Duman.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the day guimao in the first month, Su Dingfang presented the captured Duman as tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲子，如并州。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, he went to Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi he went to Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，次長平，賜父老布帛。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he stopped at Changping and granted cloth and silk to the elders.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi he halted at Changping and granted cloth and silk to the local elders.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，赦并州及所過州縣，義旗初嘗任五品以上葬并州者祭之，加佐命功臣食別封者子孫二階，大將軍府僚佐存者一階，民年八十以上版授刺史、縣令，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the second month, Bingzhou and prefectures and counties he passed through were granted amnesty; those who at the beginning of the righteous banner had once held fifth rank or above and were buried in Bingzhou were sacrificed to; descendants of meritorious ministers who aided the founding and received additional fiefs were granted two grades; surviving staff of the grand general's office were granted one grade; commoners eighty years and above were granted honorary appointment as prefect or magistrate; festive drinking was granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the second month he granted amnesty in Bingzhou and along his route. He sacrificed to those who at the founding of the dynasty had once held fifth rank or above and were buried in Bingzhou. Descendants of founding ministers who had received additional fiefs were granted two grades of merit, surviving staff of the grand general's office one grade, and commoners aged eighty and above were honorarily appointed prefect or magistrate. Festive drinking was granted for three days.

sentences.zh: 甲午，祠舊宅。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, he sacrificed at the old residence.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu he sacrificed at the old residence.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，皇后宴親族鄰里于朝堂，會命婦于內殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the third month, the empress feasted kinsmen and neighbors in the court hall and gathered married women in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the third month the empress feasted kinsmen and neighbors in the court hall and gathered married women of good family in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 賜從官五品以上、并州長史司馬勳一轉。

translations.literal: Attending officials fifth rank and above, the chief secretary and assistant administrator of Bingzhou, were granted one degree of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Attending officials fifth rank and above, and the chief secretary and assistant administrator of Bingzhou, were each granted one degree of merit.

sentences.zh: 婦人八十以上版授郡君，賜氊衾粟帛。

translations.literal: Women eighty years and above were granted honorary appointment as district lady; felt quilts, grain, and silk were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Women aged eighty and above were honorarily appointed district ladies and granted felt quilts, grain, and silk.

sentences.zh: 己酉，講武于城西。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, military exercises were conducted west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou he conducted military exercises west of the city.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，左武衛大將軍蘇定方為神兵道行軍大總管，新羅王金春秋為嵎夷道行軍總管，率三將軍及新羅兵以伐百濟。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Left Martial Guard Grand General Su Dingfang was made grand campaign general of the Shenbing Route; King Geunchogo of Silla was made campaign general of the Yuyi Route; they led three generals and Silla troops to campaign against Baekje.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai Su Dingfang, grand general of the Left Martial Guard, was appointed grand campaign general of the Shenbing Route, and King Geunchogo of Silla was appointed campaign general of the Yuyi Route. They led three generals and Silla troops to campaign against Baekje.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the fourth month, he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the fourth month he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，作八關宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the fifth month, the Palaces of the Eight Passes were built.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the fifth month he built the Palaces of the Eight Passes.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，定襄都督阿史德樞賔為沙磚道行軍總管，以伐契丹。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Protector Ashide Shu'bin of Dingxiang was made campaign general of the Shazhuan Route to campaign against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen Ashide Shu'bin, protector of Dingxiang, was appointed campaign general of the Shazhuan Route to campaign against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengwu in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day gengwu in the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 七月乙巳，廢梁王忠為庶人。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the seventh month, Prince of Liang Zhong was deposed and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the seventh month he deposed Prince of Liang Zhong and reduced him to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，盧承慶罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Lu Chengqing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao Lu Chengqing was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，蘇定方及百濟戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the eighth month, Su Dingfang fought Baekje and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the eighth month Su Dingfang fought Baekje and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，左武衛大將軍鄭仁泰及悉結、拔也固、僕骨、同羅戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Left Martial Guard Grand General Zheng Rentai fought the Xijie, Bayegu, Pugu, and Tongluo and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu Zheng Rentai, grand general of the Left Martial Guard, fought the Xijie, Bayegu, Pugu, and Tongluo tribes and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 癸未，赦神兵道大總管以下軍士及其家，賜民酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, soldiers from the grand campaign general of the Shenbing Route downward and their families were granted amnesty; festive drinking was granted to the people for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei he granted amnesty to soldiers of the Shenbing Route grand campaign command and below, together with their families, and granted the people three days of festive drinking.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，蘇定方俘百濟王以獻。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the eleventh month, Su Dingfang presented the captured King of Baekje.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the eleventh month Su Dingfang presented the captured king of Baekje as tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，如許州。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, he went to Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin he went to Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，獵于安樂川。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the twelfth month, he hunted at Anle River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei in the twelfth month he hunted at Anle River.

sentences.zh: 己卯，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，左驍衛大將軍契苾何力為浿江道行軍大總管，蘇定方為遼東道行軍大總管，左驍衛將軍劉伯英為平壤道行軍大總管，以伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Left Swift Cavalry Guard Grand General Qibi Heli was made grand campaign general of the Peijiang Route; Su Dingfang was made grand campaign general of the Liaodong Route; Left Swift Cavalry Guard General Liu Boying was made grand campaign general of the Pyongyang Route, to campaign against Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu Qibi Heli, grand general of the Left Swift Cavalry Guard, was appointed grand campaign general of the Peijiang Route; Su Dingfang was appointed grand campaign general of the Liaodong Route; and Liu Boying, general of the Left Swift Cavalry Guard, was appointed grand campaign general of the Pyongyang Route to campaign against Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 阿史德樞賔及奚、契丹戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Ashide Shu'bin fought the Xi and Khitan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Ashide Shu'bin fought the Xi and Khitan and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 三年正月乙丑，李義府為右相。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the day yichou in the first month, Li Yifu was made Right Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the day yichou in the first month, Li Yifu was appointed right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 二月，減百官一月俸，賦雍、同等十五州民錢，以作蓬萊宮。

translations.literal: In the second month, officials' salary was reduced by one month; money was levied from the people of Yong, Tong, and thirteen other prefectures to build Penglai Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he cut officials' salaries by one month and levied money from the people of Yong, Tong, and thirteen other prefectures to build Penglai Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，殺駙馬都尉韋正矩。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Imperial Son-in-law Commandant Wei Zhengju was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai Wei Zhengju, commandant and imperial son-in-law, was executed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 四月戊子，流李義府于巂州。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the fourth month, Li Yifu was exiled to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the fourth month Li Yifu was exiled to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，柳州蠻叛，冀州都督長史劉伯英以嶺南兵伐之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the fifth month, the barbarians of Liuzhou rebelled; Liu Boying, chief secretary of the protector-general of Jizhou, led Lingnan troops to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the fifth month the barbarians of Liuzhou rebelled. Liu Boying, chief secretary to the protector-general of Jizhou, led Lingnan troops to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 六月，吐蕃攻吐谷渾，涼州都督鄭仁泰為青海道行軍大總管以救之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Tibet attacked Tuyuhun; Protector-general of Liangzhou Zheng Rentai was made grand campaign general of the Qinghai Route to rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Tibet attacked Tuyuhun. Zheng Rentai, protector-general of Liangzhou, was appointed grand campaign general of the Qinghai Route to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，有彗星出于左攝提。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the eighth month, a comet appeared at Left Sheti.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the eighth month a comet appeared at Left Sheti.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔百寮言事。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict ordered all officials to report on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen he decreed that all officials should submit memorials on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 遣按察大使于十道。

translations.literal: Inspection commissioners were dispatched to the ten circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched inspection commissioners to the ten circuits.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，孫仁師及百濟戰于白江，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the ninth month, Sun Renshi fought Baekje at Bai River and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the ninth month Sun Renshi fought Baekje at Bai River and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，詔皇太子五日一至光順門，監諸司奏事，小事決之。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the tenth month, an edict ordered the crown prince to come once every five days to the Gate of Bright Compliance to oversee memorials from all offices and decide minor matters.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the tenth month he decreed that the crown prince should come once every five days to the Gate of Bright Compliance to oversee memorials from all offices and decide minor matters.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，雨木冰。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the eleventh month, there was rain with frozen tree coating.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the eleventh month there was freezing rain that coated the trees.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，改明年為麟德元年，降京師、雍州諸縣死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the twelfth month, the next year was renamed the first year of Qide; sentences below capital punishment in the capital and counties of Yongzhou were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the twelfth month he renamed the coming year the first year of Qide and commuted sentences below capital punishment in the capital and the counties of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，安西都護高賢為行軍總管，以伐弓月。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Protector-general of Anxi Gao Xian was made campaign general to campaign against Gongyue.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin Gao Xian, protector-general of Anxi, was appointed campaign general to campaign against Gongyue.

sentences.zh: 麟德元年二月戊子，如福昌宮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qide, on the day wuzi in the second month, he went to Fuchang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qide, on the day wuzi in the second month, he went to Fuchang Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，如萬年宮。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, he went to Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao he went to Wannian Palace.

sentences.zh: 四月壬午，道王元慶薨。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the fourth month, Prince of Dao Yuanqing died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the fourth month Yuanqing, Prince of Dao, died.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，許王孝薨。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the fifth month, Prince of Xu Xiao died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the fifth month Xiao, Prince of Xu, died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以旱避正殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, due to drought he avoided the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall.

sentences.zh: 七月丁未，詔以三年正月有事于泰山。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the seventh month, an edict ordered that in the first month of the third year there would be rites at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei in the seventh month he decreed that in the first month of the third year he would perform the rites at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，幸舊第，降萬年縣死罪以下。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the eighth month, he visited the old residence; sentences below capital punishment in Wannian County were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the eighth month he visited his old residence and commuted sentences below capital punishment in Wannian County.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自萬年宮。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he returned from Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu he returned from Wannian Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，司列太常伯劉祥道兼右相，大司憲竇德玄為司元太常伯、檢校左相。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Minister of Rites of the Court Liu Xiangdao was made concurrent Right Chancellor; Grand Censor Dou Dexuan was made Minister of Origin of the Rites Court and acting Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai Liu Xiangdao, minister of rites of the court, was appointed concurrent right chancellor, and Dou Dexuan, grand censor, was appointed minister of origin of the rites court and acting left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，殺上官儀。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the twelfth month, Shangguan Yi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the twelfth month Shangguan Yi was executed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，殺庶人忠。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the commoner Zhong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi the commoner Zhong was executed.

sentences.zh: 劉祥道罷。

translations.literal: Liu Xiangdao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiangdao was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 太子右中護樂彥瑋、西臺侍郎孫處約同知軍國政事。

translations.literal: Right Middle Guardian of the Crown Prince Yue Yanwei and Secretary of the Western Terrace Sun Chuyue jointly managed military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Yanwei, right middle guardian of the crown prince, and Sun Chuyue, secretary of the western terrace, were jointly appointed to manage military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無雪。

translations.literal: That winter, there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 乾封元年正月戊辰，封于泰山。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianfeng, on the day wuchen in the first month, he performed the feng rite at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianfeng, on the day wuchen in the first month, he performed the feng rite at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禪于社首，以皇后為亞獻。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he performed the shan rite at Sheshou; the empress served as secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu he performed the shan rite at Sheshou, with the empress serving as secondary offerer.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted grades, merit degrees, and noble ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He granted grades, merit degrees, and noble ranks to civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 民年八十以上版授下州刺史、司馬、縣令，婦人郡、縣君；

translations.literal: Commoners eighty years and above were granted honorary appointment as lower-grade prefect, assistant administrator, or magistrate; women as district or county ladies;
translations.idiomatic: Commoners aged eighty and above were honorarily appointed lower-grade prefect, assistant administrator, or magistrate, and women were appointed district or county ladies;

sentences.zh: 七十以上至八十，賜古爵一級。

translations.literal: Those from seventy to eighty were granted one grade of ancient noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those between seventy and eighty were granted one grade of ancient noble rank.

sentences.zh: 民酺七日，女子百戶牛酒。

translations.literal: Festive drinking was granted to the people for seven days; a hundred households of women were granted oxen and wine.
translations.idiomatic: The people were granted seven days of festive drinking, and every hundred households of women were granted oxen and wine.

sentences.zh: 免所過今年租賦，給復齊州一年半、兗州二年。

translations.literal: This year's land tax and levies along the route were exempted; Qizhou was granted one and a half years' tax and corvée exemption, Yanzhou two years.
translations.idiomatic: He exempted this year's land tax and levies along his route, granted Qizhou one and a half years' tax and corvée exemption, and Yanzhou two years.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，幸曲阜，祠孔子，贈太師。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, he visited Qufu, sacrificed to Confucius, and posthumously granted him the title Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao he visited Qufu, sacrificed to Confucius, and posthumously granted him the title of grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，如亳州，祠老子，追號太上玄元皇帝，縣人宗姓給復一年。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the second month, he went to Bozhou, sacrificed to Laozi, and posthumously honored him as Emperor Supreme Mysterious Origin; those of the imperial surname in the county were granted one year of tax and corvée exemption.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei in the second month he went to Bozhou, sacrificed to Laozi, and posthumously honored him as Emperor Supreme Mysterious Origin. Residents of the county who bore the imperial surname were granted one year of tax and corvée exemption.

sentences.zh: 四月甲辰，至自亳州。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen in the fourth month, he returned from Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen in the fourth month he returned from Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，陸敦信罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Lu Dunxin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Lu Dunxin was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，高麗泉男生請內附，右驍衛大將軍契苾何力為遼東安撫大使，率兵援之。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the sixth month, Jeon Nam-seon of Goguryeo requested to submit inward; Right Swift Cavalry Guard Grand General Qibi Heli was made Liaodong pacification commissioner to lead troops to aid him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin in the sixth month Jeon Nam-seon of Goguryeo requested to submit to the empire. Qibi Heli, grand general of the Right Swift Cavalry Guard, was appointed Liaodong pacification commissioner to lead troops to his aid.

sentences.zh: 左金吾衛將軍龐同善、營州都督高侃為遼東道行軍總管，左武衛將軍薛仁貴、左監門衛將軍李謹行為後援。

translations.literal: Left Golden Guard General Pang Tongshan and Protector-general of Yingzhou Gao Kan were made campaign generals of the Liaodong Route; Left Martial Guard General Xue Rengui and Left Gate Guard General Li Jinhang served as rear support.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Tongshan, general of the Left Golden Guard, and Gao Kan, protector-general of Yingzhou, were appointed campaign generals of the Liaodong Route, with Xue Rengui, general of the Left Martial Guard, and Li Jinhang, general of the Left Gate Guard, serving as rear support.

sentences.zh: 七月乙丑，徙封旭輪為豫王。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the seventh month, Xulun's fief was changed and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the seventh month he changed Xulun's fief and enfeoffed him as Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，劉仁軌兼右相。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Liu Rengui was made concurrent Right Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu Liu Rengui was appointed concurrent right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，竇德玄薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the eighth month, Dou Dexuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the eighth month Dou Dexuan died.

sentences.zh: 丁未，殺始州刺史武惟良、淄州刺史武懷運。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Wu Weiliang, prefect of Shizhou, and Wu Huaiyun, prefect of Zizhou, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei Wu Weiliang, prefect of Shizhou, and Wu Huaiyun, prefect of Zizhou, were executed.

sentences.zh: 九月，龐同善及高麗戰，敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Pang Tongshan fought Goguryeo and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Pang Tongshan fought Goguryeo and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，李勣為遼東道行臺大總管，率六總管兵以伐高麗。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the twelfth month, Li Ji was made grand campaign general of the Liaodong Field Secretariat and led troops of six campaign generals to campaign against Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou in the twelfth month Li Ji was appointed grand campaign general of the Liaodong field secretariat and led the forces of six campaign generals against Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丁丑，以旱避正殿，減膳，慮囚。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the day dingchou in the first month, due to drought he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the day dingchou in the first month, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, and reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，涪陵郡王愔薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the second month, Prince of Fuling Yin died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the second month Yin, Prince of Fuling, died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，禁工商乗馬。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, merchants and artisans were forbidden to ride horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou he forbade merchants and artisans from riding horses.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，西臺侍郎楊武戴至德、東臺侍郎李安期、司列少常伯趙仁本同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the sixth month, Secretary of the Western Terrace Yang Wudaizhide, Secretary of the Eastern Terrace Li Anqi, and Junior Minister of the Court Zhao Renben were made associates of the third rank of the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao in the sixth month Yang Wudaizhide, secretary of the western terrace, Li Anqi, secretary of the eastern terrace, and Zhao Renben, junior minister of the court, were appointed associates of the eastern and western terraces of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 東臺舍人張文瓘參知政事。

translations.literal: Eastern Terrace Drafting Officer Zhang Wenwan joined in governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenwan, drafter of the eastern terrace, joined in governing affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月己卯，以旱避正殿，減膳，遣使慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the seventh month, due to drought he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, and sent envoys to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the seventh month, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, and sent envoys to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day jichou in the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jichou in the eighth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，李安期罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Li Anqi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai Li Anqi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，以餌藥，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the ninth month, owing to taking elixir medicine, the crown prince supervised the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen in the ninth month, while the emperor consumed elixirs, the crown prince supervised state affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，李勣及高麗戰于新城，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Li Ji fought Goguryeo at Xincheng and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Li Ji fought Goguryeo at Xincheng and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，嶺南洞獠陷瓊州。

translations.literal: That year, the cave Liao of Lingnan captured Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year the cave tribes of Lingnan captured Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 總章元年正月壬子，劉仁軌為遼東道副大總管兼安撫大使、浿江道行軍總管。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zongzhang, on the day renzi in the first month, Liu Rengui was made deputy grand campaign general of the Liaodong Route, concurrent pacification commissioner, and campaign general of the Peijiang Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zongzhang, on the day renzi in the first month Liu Rengui was appointed deputy grand campaign general of the Liaodong Route, concurrent pacification commissioner, and campaign general of the Peijiang Route.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，皇太子釋奠于國學。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the second month, the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the second month the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the National University.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，如九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬午，李勣敗高麗，克扶餘、南蘇、木底、蒼巖城。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Li Ji defeated Goguryeo and captured the cities of Fuyu, Nansu, Mudi, and Cangyan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu Li Ji defeated Goguryeo and captured Fuyu, Nansu, Mudi, and Cangyan.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the third month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the third month he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 四月乙卯，贈顏回太子少師，曾參太子少保。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the fourth month, Yan Hui was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor to the Crown Prince, and Zeng Shen Junior Protector to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao in the fourth month Yan Hui was posthumously named Junior Preceptor to the crown prince and Zeng Shen Junior Protector to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，有彗星出于五車，避正殿，減膳，撤樂，詔內外官言事。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, a comet appeared at Wuche; he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, withdrew music, and ordered inner and outer officials to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen a comet appeared at Wuche. He avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, withdrew court music, and ordered officials throughout the court to submit memorials on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以太原元從西府功臣為二等：第一功後官無五品者，授其子若孫一人，有至四品五品者加二階，有三品以上加爵三等；

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the original followers from Taiyuan and meritorious officials of the Western Office were divided into two grades: for first-grade merit, if the posthumous office rank was below fifth rank, one son or grandson was granted office; if it reached fourth or fifth rank, two ranks were added; if third rank or above, three grades of nobility were added;
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen the original followers from Taiyuan and meritorious officials of the Western Office were divided into two grades. For first-grade merit, if the deceased held no fifth-rank office, one son or grandson received an appointment; those who had reached fourth or fifth rank received a two-rank promotion; those of third rank or above received three grades of nobility;

sentences.zh: 第二功後官無五品者，授其子若孫從六品一人，有至五品者加一階，六品者二階，三品以上爵一等。

translations.literal: for second-grade merit, if the posthumous office rank was below fifth rank, one son or grandson was granted office of sixth-rank attendant status; if it reached fifth rank, one rank was added; if sixth rank, two ranks; if third rank or above, one grade of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: For second-grade merit, if the deceased held no fifth-rank office, one son or grandson was appointed at the attendant sixth rank. Those who had reached fifth rank received one promotion; those at sixth rank received two; those of third rank or above received one grade of nobility.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，楊武薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Yang Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi Yang Wu died.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the eighth month, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the eighth month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，李勣敗高麗王高藏，執之。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the ninth month, Li Ji defeated Goguryeo King Gao Zang and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the ninth month Li Ji defeated Goguryeo King Gao Zang and captured him.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，俘高藏以獻。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the twelfth month, the captive Gao Zang was presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the twelfth month the captive Gao Zang was presented.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the suburban sacrifice was performed at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao he performed the suburban sacrifice at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，姜恪檢校左相，司平太常伯閻立本守右相。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Jiang Ke was made acting Left Chancellor; Yan Liben, Minister of Equilibrium of the Rites Court, served as Right Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Jiang Ke was appointed acting left chancellor, and Yan Liben, minister of equilibrium of the rites court, served as right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 咸亨元年正月丁丑，劉仁軌罷。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianheng, on the day dingchou in the first month, Liu Rengui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianheng, on the day dingchou in the first month Liu Rengui was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the second month, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the second month he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，東南有聲若雷。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, there was a sound like thunder in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi a sound like thunder was heard in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the third month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the third month he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，許敬宗罷。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Xu Jingzong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen Xu Jingzong was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 四月癸卯，吐蕃陷龜茲撥換城。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the fourth month, Tibet captured the Bozhuan fortress of Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the fourth month Tibet captured the Bozhuan fortress of Kucha.

sentences.zh: 廢安西四鎮。

translations.literal: The four garrisons of Anxi were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The four garrisons of Anxi were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己酉，李敬玄罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Li Jingxuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou Li Jingxuan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，右威衛大將軍薛仁貴為邏娑道行軍大總管，以伐吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Right Bright Guard Grand General Xue Rengui was made grand campaign general of the Luosuo Route to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai Xue Rengui, grand general of the Right Bright Guard, was appointed grand campaign general of the Luosuo Route to campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 庚午，如九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 雍州大雨雹。

translations.literal: Yongzhou had great rain and hail.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzhou had heavy rain and hail.

sentences.zh: 高麗酋長鉗牟岑叛，寇邊，左監門衛大將軍高侃為東州道行軍總管，右領軍衛大將軍李謹行為燕山道行軍總管，以伐之。

translations.literal: Goguryeo chieftain Qian Mucen rebelled and raided the border; Left Gate Guard Grand General Gao Kan was made campaign general of the Dongzhou Route, and Right Army Guard Grand General Li Jinhang was made campaign general of the Yanshan Route to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo chieftain Qian Mucen rebelled and raided the frontier. Gao Kan, grand general of the Left Gate Guard, was appointed campaign general of the Dongzhou Route, and Li Jinhang, grand general of the Right Army Guard, was appointed campaign general of the Yanshan Route to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day renyin in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renyin in the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 七月甲戌，以雍、華、蒲、同四州旱，遣使慮囚，減中御諸廄馬。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the seventh month, because of drought in the four prefectures of Yong, Hua, Pu, and Tong, envoys were sent to review prisoners and the horses of the imperial stables were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the seventh month, owing to drought in Yong, Hua, Pu, and Tong prefectures, he sent envoys to review prisoners and reduced the horses of the imperial stables.

sentences.zh: 戊子，李敬玄起復。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Li Jingxuan resumed office after mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi Li Jingxuan resumed office after mourning.

sentences.zh: 薛仁貴及吐蕃戰于大非川，敗績。

translations.literal: Xue Rengui fought Tibet at Dafeichuan and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Rengui fought Tibet at Dafeichuan and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，以穀貴禁酒。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the eighth month, because grain was costly, wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu in the eighth month, because grain was costly, he prohibited the making of wine.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，趙王福薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Zhao Wang Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi Fu, Prince of Zhao, died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以旱避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, due to drought he avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，給復雍、華、同、岐、邠、隴六州一年。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the ninth month, one year of tax and corvée exemption was granted to the six prefectures of Yong, Hua, Tong, Qi, Bin, and Long.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou in the ninth month he granted one year of tax and corvée exemption to the six prefectures of Yong, Hua, Tong, Qi, Bin, and Long.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸卯，皇后以旱請避位。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the intercalary month, the empress, owing to drought, requested to step down from her position.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the intercalary month the empress, owing to drought, requested to step down from her position.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，姜恪為涼州道行軍大總管，以伐吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Jiang Ke was made grand campaign general of the Liangzhou Route to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin Jiang Ke was appointed grand campaign general of the Liangzhou Route to campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰，詔文武官言事。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the tenth month, civil and military officials were ordered to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the tenth month he ordered civil and military officials to submit memorials on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 乙未，趙仁本罷。

translations.literal: On the day weiwei, Zhao Renben was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day weiwei Zhao Renben was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，復官名。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the twelfth month, official titles were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the twelfth month official titles were restored.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大饑。

translations.literal: That year, there was a great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year there was a great famine.

sentences.zh: 二年正月乙巳，如東都，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the day yisi in the first month, he went to the Eastern Capital and the crown prince supervised the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the day yisi in the first month he went to the Eastern Capital, and the crown prince supervised state affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，遣使存問諸州。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the second month, envoys were sent to inquire after the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei in the second month he sent envoys to inquire after the various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 四月戊子，大風，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the fourth month, there were great winds and hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the fourth month there were great winds and hail.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，以旱慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the sixth month, owing to drought prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the sixth month, owing to drought, he reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 九月，地震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丙申，徐王元禮薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Xu Wang Yuanli died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen Yuanli, Prince of Xu, died.

sentences.zh: 十月丙子，求明禮樂之士。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the tenth month, scholars versed in rites and music were sought.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi in the tenth month scholars versed in rites and music were sought.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day jiawu in the eleventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiawu in the eleventh month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，如許州，遣使存問所過疾老鰥寡，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, he went to Xuzhou, sent envoys to inquire after the sick, elderly, widowed, and orphaned along the route, and reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu he went to Xuzhou, sent envoys to inquire after the sick, elderly, widowed, and orphaned along his route, and reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，獵于昆陽。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the twelfth month, he hunted at Kunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the twelfth month he hunted at Kunyang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，姜恪為侍中，閻立本為中書令。

translations.literal: That year, Jiang Ke was made Palace Attendant and Yan Liben was made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiang Ke was appointed palace attendant and Yan Liben was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 四年正月丙辰，鄭王元懿薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, on the day bingchen in the first month, Zheng Wang Yuanyi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the day bingchen in the first month Yuanyi, Prince of Zheng, died.

sentences.zh: 四月丙子，如九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the fourth month, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi in the fourth month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 閏五月丁卯，禁作簺捕魚、營圈取獸者。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the intercalary fifth month, those who made dams to fish and built enclosures to capture game were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the intercalary fifth month he prohibited dam fishing and building enclosures to capture game.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，以不豫詔皇太子聽諸司啟事。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the eighth month, owing to illness he ordered the crown prince to hear reports from all offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the eighth month, owing to illness, he ordered the crown prince to hear reports from all offices.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大風落太廟鴟尾。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, great winds knocked down the owl-tail ornaments of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou great winds knocked down the owl-tail ornaments of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十月壬午，閻立本薨。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the tenth month, Yan Liben died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the tenth month Yan Liben died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以皇太子納妃，赦岐州，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day weiwei, because the crown prince took a consort, Qizhou was granted amnesty and three days of festive drinking were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day weiwei, because the crown prince took a consort, Qizhou was granted amnesty and the people were granted three days of festive drinking.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 上元元年二月壬午，劉仁軌為雞林道行軍大總管，以伐新羅。
