translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shangyuan, on the day renwu in the second month Liu Rengui was appointed grand campaign general of the Jilin Route to campaign against Silla.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day xinhai in the third month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day xinhai in the third month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇后親蠶。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the empress personally tended silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi the empress personally tended silkworms.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，皇帝稱天皇，皇后稱天后。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the eighth month, the emperor styled himself Heavenly Sovereign and the empress styled herself Heavenly Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the eighth month the emperor styled himself Heavenly Sovereign and the empress styled herself Heavenly Empress.

sentences.zh: 追尊六代祖宣簡公為宣皇帝，妣張氏曰宣莊皇后；

translations.literal: The sixth-generation ancestor Duke Xuanjian was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan, and his mother Lady Zhang was styled Empress Xuanzhuang;
translations.idiomatic: The sixth-generation ancestor Duke Xuanjian was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan, and his mother Lady Zhang of the Zhang clan was styled Empress Xuanzhuang;

sentences.zh: 五代祖懿王為光皇帝，妣賈氏曰光懿皇后。

translations.literal: the fifth-generation ancestor King Yi was posthumously honored as Emperor Guang, and his mother Lady Jia was styled Empress Guangyi.
translations.idiomatic: the fifth-generation ancestor King Yi was posthumously honored as Emperor Guang, and his mother Lady Jia of the Jia clan was styled Empress Guangyi.

sentences.zh: 增高祖、太宗及后謚。

translations.literal: The posthumous titles of Gaozu, Taizong, and the empresses were elevated.
translations.idiomatic: The posthumous titles of Gaozu, Taizong, and the empresses were elevated.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and three days of festive drinking were granted.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty, changed the era name, and granted three days of festive drinking.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the eleventh month, he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the eleventh month he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己酉，獵于華山曲武原。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, he hunted at Quwuyuan on Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou he hunted at Quwuyuan on Mount Hua.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，蔣王惲自殺。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the twelfth month, Jiang Wang Yun committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the twelfth month Yun, Prince of Jiang, committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 二年正月己未，給復雍、同、華、岐、隴五州一年。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the day jiwei in the first month, one year of tax and corvée exemption was granted to the five prefectures of Yong, Tong, Hua, Qi, and Long.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the day jiwei in the first month he granted one year of tax and corvée exemption to the five prefectures of Yong, Tong, Hua, Qi, and Long.

sentences.zh: 辛未，吐蕃請和。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Tibet requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Tibet requested peace.

sentences.zh: 二月，劉仁軌及新羅戰于七重城，敗之。

translations.literal: In the second month, Liu Rengui fought Silla at Qizhong Fort and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Liu Rengui fought Silla at Qizhong Fort and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，天后親蠶。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the third month, the Heavenly Empress personally tended silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the third month the Heavenly Empress personally tended silkworms.

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，天后殺周王顯妃趙氏。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the fourth month, the Heavenly Empress killed Zhao, consort of Zhou Wang Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the fourth month the Heavenly Empress killed Lady Zhao, consort of Xian, Prince of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以旱避正殿，減膳，撤樂，詔百官言事。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, owing to drought he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, withdrew music, and ordered all officials to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, withdrew court music, and ordered all officials to submit memorials on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 己亥，天后殺皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the Heavenly Empress killed the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai the Heavenly Empress killed the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，追號皇太子為孝敬皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the fifth month, the crown prince was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the fifth month the crown prince was posthumously titled Emperor Xiaojing.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，立雍王賢為皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the sixth month, Yong Wang Xian was established as crown prince, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the sixth month Xian, Prince of Yong, was established as crown prince, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，杞王上金免官，削封邑。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the seventh month, Qi Wang Shangjin was removed from office and his fief was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the seventh month Shangjin, Prince of Qi, was removed from office and his fief was reduced.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，葬孝敬皇帝于恭陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the eighth month, Emperor Xiaojing was buried at Gongling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the eighth month Emperor Xiaojing was buried at Gongling.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔婦人為宮官者歲一見其親。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered that palace women serving as palace officials should see their parents once each year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou he decreed that palace women serving as palace officials should see their parents once each year.

sentences.zh: 庚子，張文瓘為侍中，郝處俊為中書令，劉仁軌為尚書左僕射，戴至德為右僕射。

translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi Zhang Wenwan was appointed palace attendant, Hao Chujun was appointed secretariat director, Liu Rengui was appointed left vice director of the Department of State, and Dai Zhide was appointed right vice director.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰，雍州雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the tenth month, Yongzhou had hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the tenth month Yongzhou had hail.

sentences.zh: 壬午，有彗星出于角、亢。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a comet appeared at Jiao and Kang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu a comet appeared at Jiao and Kang.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳元年正月壬戌，徙封輪為相王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yifeng, on the day renxu in the first month, Lun was transferred to the title of Prince of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yifeng, on the day renxu in the first month Lun was transferred to the title of Prince of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，納州獠寇邊。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the Liao of Nazhou raided the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao the Liao of Nazhou raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，如汝州溫湯，遣使慮免汝州輕繫。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the second month, he went to the hot springs at Ruzhou, and sent envoys to review and pardon minor prisoners in Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the second month he went to the hot springs at Ruzhou and sent envoys to review and pardon minor prisoners there.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，黃門侍郎來恒、中書侍郎薛元超同中書門下三品。

translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the third month Lai Heng, secretary of the yellow gate, and Xue Yuanchao, secretary of the secretariat, were appointed associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，如東都，免汝州今歲半租，賜民八十以上帛。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, he went to the Eastern Capital, exempted Ruzhou from half this year's land tax, and granted silk to commoners aged eighty and above.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen he went to the Eastern Capital, exempted Ruzhou from half this year's land tax, and granted silk to commoners aged eighty and above.

sentences.zh: 閏月己巳，吐蕃寇鄯、廓、河、芳四州，左監門衛中郎將令狐智通伐之。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the intercalary month, Tibet raided the four prefectures of Shan, Kuo, He, and Fang; Central Commandant of the Left Gate Guard Linghu Zhitong campaigned against them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the intercalary month Tibet raided Shan, Kuo, He, and Fang prefectures. Linghu Zhitong, central commandant of the Left Gate Guard, campaigned against them.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，周王顯為洮河道行軍元帥，領左衛大將軍劉審禮等十二總管，相王輪為涼州道行軍元帥，領契苾何力等軍，以伐吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Zhou Wang Xian was made marshaling commander of the Taohe Route, leading twelve campaign generals including Left Guard Grand General Liu Shenli; Xiang Wang Lun was made marshaling commander of the Liangzhou Route, leading the forces of Qibi Heli and others, to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou Xian, Prince of Zhou, was appointed marshaling commander of the Taohe Route, leading twelve campaign generals including Liu Shenli, grand general of the Left Guard; Lun, Prince of Xiang, was appointed marshaling commander of the Liangzhou Route, leading the forces of Qibi Heli and others, to campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 四月戊甲，至自東都。

translations.literal: On the day wujia in the fourth month, he returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the fourth month he returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，中書侍郎李義琰同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Secretary of the Secretariat Li Yiyan was made associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin Li Yiyan, secretary of the secretariat, was appointed associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，如九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，黃門侍郎高智周同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the sixth month, Secretary of the Yellow Gate Gao Zhizhou was made associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai in the sixth month Gao Zhizhou, secretary of the yellow gate, was appointed associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 七月丁亥，有彗星出于東井。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the seventh month, a comet appeared at Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the seventh month a comet appeared at Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 乙未，吐蕃寇疊州。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Tibet raided Diezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei Tibet raided Die Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，避正殿，減膳，撤樂，損食粟馬，慮囚，詔文武官言事。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the eighth month, he avoided the main hall, reduced meals, withdrew music, cut grain rations for horses, reviewed prisoners, and ordered civil and military officials to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the eighth month he avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, withdrew court music, cut grain rations for horses, reviewed prisoners, and ordered civil and military officials to submit memorials on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 甲子，停南北中尚、梨園、作坊，減少府雜匠。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Southern and Northern Central Workshops, Pear Garden, and craft shops were suspended, and the assorted artisans of the Palace Workshop were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi he suspended the Southern and Northern Central Workshops, the Pear Garden, and the craft shops, and reduced the assorted artisans of the Palace Workshop.

sentences.zh: 是月，青州海溢。

translations.literal: That month, the sea overflowed at Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month the sea overflowed at Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the tenth month, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei in the tenth month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙午，降封郇王素節鄱陽郡王。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Prince of Xun Su Jie was demoted and transferred to Prince of Poyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu Su Jie, Prince of Xun, was demoted to Prince of Poyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the eleventh month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen in the eleventh month he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，李敬玄為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Li Jingxuan was made Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin Li Jingxuan was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，來恒、薛元超為河南、河北道大使。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the twelfth month, Lai Heng and Xue Yuanchao were made commissioners of the Henan and Hebei routes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the twelfth month Lai Heng and Xue Yuanchao were appointed commissioners of the Henan and Hebei routes.

sentences.zh: 二年正月乙亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the day yihai in the first month, he plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the day yihai in the first month he plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the capital had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen the capital was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四月，太子左庶子張大安同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Left Subordinate of the Heir Apparent Zhang Da'an was made associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zhang Da'an, left subordinate of the heir apparent, was appointed associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 五月，吐蕃寇扶州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Tibet raided Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Tibet raided Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，劉仁軌為洮河軍鎮守使。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the eighth month, Liu Rengui was made garrison commander of the Taohe Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the eighth month Liu Rengui was appointed garrison commander of the Taohe Army.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，徙封顯為英王，更名哲。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the tenth month, Xian was transferred to the title of Prince of Ying and renamed Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the tenth month Xian was transferred to the title of Prince of Ying and renamed Zhe.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，募關內、河東猛士，以伐吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the twelfth month, fierce warriors were recruited in Guannei and Hedong to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao in the twelfth month he recruited fierce warriors in Guannei and Hedong to campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西突厥及吐蕃寇安西。

translations.literal: That year, the Western Turks and Tibet raided Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Western Turks and Tibet raided Anxi.

sentences.zh: 冬，無雪。

translations.literal: In winter, there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙子，李敬玄為洮河道行軍大總管，以伐吐蕃。

translations.literal: In the third year, on the day bingzi in the first month, Li Jingxuan was made grand campaign general of the Taohe Route to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the day bingzi in the first month Li Jingxuan was appointed grand campaign general of the Taohe Route to campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣使募河南、河北猛士，以伐吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, envoys were sent to recruit fierce warriors in Henan and Hebei to campaign against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei he sent envoys to recruit fierce warriors in Henan and Hebei to campaign against Tibet.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，以旱避正殿，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the fourth month, owing to drought he avoided the main hall and reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the fourth month, owing to drought, he avoided the main hall and reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大赦，改明年為通乾元年。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the next year was changed to the first year of Tongqian.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the next year to the first year of Tongqian.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，涇州民生子異體連心。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, a commoner of Jingzhou gave birth to conjoined twins sharing one body.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou a commoner of Jing Prefecture gave birth to conjoined twins sharing one body.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，如九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the fifth month, he went to Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the fifth month he went to Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 大雨霖。

translations.literal: Great rain fell in torrents.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains fell in torrents.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，至自九成宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the ninth month, he returned from Jiucheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the ninth month he returned from Jiucheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，張文瓘薨。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhang Wenwan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai Zhang Wenwan died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，李敬玄、劉審禮及吐蕃戰于青海，敗績，審禮死之。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Li Jingxuan and Liu Shenli fought Tibet at Qinghai and suffered defeat; Shenli died in the battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin Li Jingxuan and Liu Shenli fought Tibet at Qinghai and suffered defeat; Liu Shenli was killed.

sentences.zh: 十月丙申，停劍南、隴右歲貢。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the tenth month, the annual tribute from Jiannan and Longyou was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen in the tenth month he suspended the annual tribute from Jiannan and Longyou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，密王元曉薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Mi Wang Yuanxiao died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu Yuanxiao, Prince of Mi, died.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月丙申，雨木冰。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the intercalary eleventh month, rain froze on the trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen in the intercalary eleventh month rain froze on the trees.

sentences.zh: 壬子，來恒薨。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Lai Heng died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi Lai Heng died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，罷通乾號。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the twelfth month, the era name Tongqian was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the twelfth month he abolished the era name Tongqian.

sentences.zh: 調露元年正月戊子，如東都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiaolu, on the day wuzi in the first month, he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tiaolu, on the day wuzi in the first month he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，戴至德薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Dai Zhide died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Dai Zhide died.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉，郝處俊為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the fourth month, Hao Chujun was made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the fourth month Hao Chujun was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the fifth month, the crown prince oversaw the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the fifth month the crown prince oversaw the state.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，作紫桂宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Zigui Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu he built Zigui Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月辛亥，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the sixth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the sixth month he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎裴行儉伐西突厥。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Pei Xingjian campaigned against the Western Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Xingjian, vice director of the Ministry of Personnel, campaigned against the Western Turks.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，行儉敗西突厥，執其可汗都支。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the ninth month, Xingjian defeated the Western Turks and captured their khan Duzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the ninth month Pei Xingjian defeated the Western Turks and captured their khan Duzhi.

sentences.zh: 十月，突厥溫傅、奉職二部寇邊，單于大都護府長史蕭嗣業伐之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the two Turkic divisions of Wenfu and Fengzhi raided the border; Chief Administrator of the Chanyu Protectorate General Xiao Siye campaigned against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the two Turkic divisions of Wenfu and Fengzhi raided the frontier. Xiao Siye, chief administrator of the Chanyu Protectorate General, campaigned against them.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，高智周罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the eleventh month, Gao Zhizhou was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the eleventh month Gao Zhizhou was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，禮部尚書裴行儉為定襄道行軍大總管，以伐突厥。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Minister of Rites Pei Xingjian was made grand campaign general of the Dingxiang Route to campaign against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen Pei Xingjian, minister of rites, was appointed grand campaign general of the Dingxiang Route to campaign against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 開耀元年正月乙亥，突厥寇原、慶二州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyao, on the day yihai in the first month, the Turks raided the two prefectures of Yuan and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaiyao, on the day yihai in the first month the Turks raided Yuan and Qing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜京官九品以上酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, capital officials of the ninth rank and above were granted three days of revelry.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi he granted three days of revelry to capital officials of the ninth rank and above.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，裴行儉為定襄道行軍大總管，以伐突厥。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Pei Xingjian was made grand campaign general of the Dingxiang Route to campaign against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi Pei Xingjian was appointed grand campaign general of the Dingxiang Route to campaign against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 己亥，減殿中、太僕馬，省諸方貢獻，免雍、岐、華、同四州二歲稅，河南、河北一年調。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the horses of the Palace Administration and the Imperial Stud were reduced, tribute from the various regions was curtailed, the four prefectures of Yong, Qi, Hua, and Tong were exempted from two years of land tax, and Henan and Hebei were exempted from one year of corvée levy.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai he reduced the horses of the palace administration and the imperial stud, curtailed tribute from the various regions, exempted Yong, Qi, Hua, and Tong prefectures from two years of land tax, and exempted Henan and Hebei from one year of corvée levy.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，皇太子釋奠于國學。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the second month, the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the second month the crown prince performed the libation sacrifice at the National University.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，郝處俊罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the third month, Hao Chujun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao in the third month Hao Chujun was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，常州人劉龍子謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the fifth month, Liu Longzi of Changzhou plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the fifth month Liu Longzi of Chang Prefecture plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，定襄道副總管曹懷舜及突厥戰于橫水，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Deputy Campaign General of the Dingxiang Route Cao Huaishun fought the Turks at Hengshui and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu Cao Huaishun, deputy campaign general of the Dingxiang Route, fought the Turks at Hengshui and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 己丑，黑齒常之及吐蕃戰于良非川，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Heichi Changzhi fought Tibet at Liangfeichuan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou Heichi Changzhi fought Tibet at Liangfeichuan and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，永嘉郡王晫有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the sixth month, Yongjia Commandery Prince Zhuo was guilty of a crime and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the sixth month Zhuo, Prince of Yongjia Commandery, was found guilty of a crime and executed.

sentences.zh: 七月己丑，以太平公主下嫁，赦京師。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the seventh month, because Princess Taiping was given in marriage, the capital was granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou in the seventh month, because Princess Taiping was given in marriage, he granted amnesty in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲午，劉仁軌罷左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Liu Rengui was removed as Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Liu Rengui was removed from office as left vice director.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，裴炎為侍中，崔知溫、薛元超守中書令。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the intercalary month, Pei Yan was made Palace Attendant; Cui Zhiwen and Xue Yuanchao were made acting Secretariat Directors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei in the intercalary month Pei Yan was appointed palace attendant, and Cui Zhiwen and Xue Yuanchao were appointed acting secretariat directors.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以餌藥，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, because he was taking elixir medicine, the crown prince oversaw the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, because he was taking elixir medicine, the crown prince oversaw the state.

sentences.zh: 庚申，裴行儉及突厥戰，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Pei Xingjian fought the Turks and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen Pei Xingjian fought the Turks and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，以河南、河北大水，遣使賑乏絕，室廬壞者給復一年，溺死者贈物，人三段。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the eighth month, because of great floods in Henan and Hebei, envoys were sent to relieve destitution; those whose dwellings were destroyed were granted one year of tax exemption, and those who drowned were granted burial goods of three lengths per person.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the eighth month, because of great floods in Henan and Hebei, he sent envoys to relieve destitution, granted one year of tax exemption to those whose dwellings were destroyed, and granted three lengths of burial goods to each person who drowned.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，有彗星出于天市。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the ninth month, a comet appeared at Tianshi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen in the ninth month a comet appeared at Tianshi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，裴行儉俘突厥溫傅可汗、阿史那伏念以獻。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Pei Xingjian captured the Turkic khan Wenfu and Ashina Funian and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu Pei Xingjian captured the Turkic khan Wenfu and Ashina Funian and presented them as captives.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改元，赦定襄軍及諸道緣征官吏兵募。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the era name was changed, and the Dingxiang Army and the officials, soldiers, and recruits attached to the various campaign routes were granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou he changed the era name and granted amnesty to the Dingxiang Army and to the officials, soldiers, and recruits attached to the various campaign routes.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingyin in the tenth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day bingyin in the tenth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，徙庶人賢于巴州。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the eleventh month, the commoner Xian was transferred to Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the eleventh month the deposed commoner Xian was transferred to Ba Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弘道元年正月甲午，幸奉天宮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongdao, on the day jiawu in the first month, he visited Fengtian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongdao, on the day jiawu in the first month he visited Fengtian Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，突厥寇定州，刺史霍王元軌敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the second month, the Turks raided Dingzhou; Prefect Huo Wang Yuangui defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu in the second month the Turks raided Ding Prefecture; Yuangui, Prince of Huo and prefect of Ding, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，突厥寇單于都護府，司馬張行師死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the third month, the Turks raided the Chanyu Protectorate General; Military Administrator Zhang Xingshi died in the battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the third month the Turks raided the Chanyu Protectorate General; Zhang Xingshi, military administrator, was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，李義琰罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Li Yiyan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi Li Yiyan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，有彗星出于五車。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, a comet appeared at Wuche.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu a comet appeared at Wuche.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，崔知溫薨。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Cui Zhiwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou Cui Zhiwen died.

sentences.zh: 四月己未，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the fourth month, he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei in the fourth month he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，郭待舉、郭正一同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Guo Daiju and Guo Zhengyi were made chief ministers of the secretariat and chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen Guo Daiju and Guo Zhengyi were appointed chief ministers of the secretariat and chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲申，綏州部落稽白鐵余寇邊，右武衛將軍程務挺敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the tribal leader Ji Baitieyu of Suizhou raided the border; General of the Right Martial Guard Cheng Wuting defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen the tribal leader Ji Baitieyu of Sui Prefecture raided the frontier. Cheng Wuting, general of the Right Martial Guard, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，突厥寇蔚州，刺史李思儉死之。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the fifth month, the Turks raided Weizhou; Prefect Li Sijian died in the battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the fifth month the Turks raided Wei Prefecture; Li Sijian, the prefect, was killed.

sentences.zh: 七月甲辰，徙封輪為豫王，改名旦。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen in the seventh month, Lun was transferred to the title of Prince of Yu and renamed Dan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen in the seventh month Lun was transferred to the title of Prince of Yu and renamed Dan.

sentences.zh: 薛元超罷。

translations.literal: Xue Yuanchao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Yuanchao was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，皇太子朝于東都，皇太孫留守京師。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the eighth month, the crown prince attended court at the Eastern Capital, and the imperial grand heir remained to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the eighth month the crown prince attended court at the Eastern Capital, and the imperial grand heir remained to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，滹沱溢。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the Hutuo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao the Hutuo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，河溢，壞河陽城。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Heyang City.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Heyang City.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，以太平公主子生，赦東都。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the ninth month, because Princess Taiping's son was born, the Eastern Capital was granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou in the ninth month, because Princess Taiping's son was born, he granted amnesty in the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十月癸亥，幸奉天宮。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the tenth month, he visited Fengtian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai in the tenth month he visited Fengtian Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，右武衛將軍程務挺為單于道安撫大使，以伐突厥。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the eleventh month, General of the Right Martial Guard Cheng Wuting was made pacification commissioner of the Chanyu Route to campaign against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the eleventh month Cheng Wuting, general of the Right Martial Guard, was appointed pacification commissioner of the Chanyu Route to campaign against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the crown prince oversaw the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou the crown prince oversaw the state.

sentences.zh: 丁未，如東都。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he went to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei he went to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，裴炎、劉齊賢、郭正一兼於東宮平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Pei Yan, Liu Qixian, and Guo Zhengyi were made concurrent chief ministers in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen Pei Yan, Liu Qixian, and Guo Zhengyi were appointed concurrent chief ministers in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，改元，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the twelfth month, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the twelfth month he changed the era name and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是夕，皇帝崩于貞觀殿，年五十六。

translations.literal: That evening, the emperor died at Zhenguan Hall, aged fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: That evening the emperor died at Zhenguan Hall at the age of fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 謚曰天皇大帝。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Heavenly Sovereign Grand Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously titled Heavenly Sovereign Grand Emperor.

sentences.zh: 天寶八載，改謚天皇大聖皇帝；

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianbao, the posthumous title was changed to Heavenly Sovereign Grand Sage Emperor;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tianbao his posthumous title was changed to Heavenly Sovereign Grand Sage Emperor;

sentences.zh: 十三載，增謚天皇大聖大弘孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the title was augmented to Heavenly Sovereign Grand Sage Grand Expansive Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year his title was augmented to Heavenly Sovereign Grand Sage Grand Expansive Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：小雅曰：「赫赫宗周，褒姒棕之。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Xiao Ya says: "Glorious was the Zhou of Zong, Bao Si ruined it."
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Xiao Ya says, "Glorious was the Zhou of Zong, Bao Si ruined it."

sentences.zh: 」此周幽王之詩也。

translations.literal: " This is a poem about King You of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: " This is a poem about King You of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 是時，幽王雖亡，而太子宜臼立，是為平王。

translations.literal: At that time, although King You perished, the crown prince Yijiu was enthroned, and he was King Ping.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, although King You perished, the crown prince Yijiu was enthroned as King Ping.

sentences.zh: 而詩人乃言棕之者，以為文、武之業於是蕩盡，東周雖在，不能復興矣。

translations.literal: Yet the poet speaks of ruin, thinking that the achievements of Wen and Wu were thereby swept away; although Eastern Zhou remained, it could no longer be revived.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the poet speaks of ruin because he thought the achievements of King Wen and King Wu were thereby swept away; although Eastern Zhou remained, it could no longer be revived.

sentences.zh: 其曰棕者，甚疾之之辭也。

translations.literal: When it says "ruin," it is language expressing extreme condemnation.
translations.idiomatic: When it says "ruin," it is language expressing extreme condemnation.

sentences.zh: 武氏之亂，唐之宗室戕殺殆盡，其賢士大夫不免者十八九。

translations.literal: In the disorder of the Wu clan, the Tang imperial clan was nearly exterminated in slaughter, and of the worthy scholar-officials, eight or nine in ten did not escape.
translations.idiomatic: In the disorder of the Wu clan the Tang imperial clan was nearly exterminated, and eight or nine in ten of the worthy scholar-officials did not escape.

sentences.zh: 以太宗之治，其遺德餘烈在人者未遠，而幾於遂絕，其為惡豈一褒姒之比邪？

translations.literal: Given the governance of Taizong, the lingering virtue and remaining influence among the people were not yet distant, yet they nearly came to an end; was the evil not more than a single Bao Si could compare to?
translations.idiomatic: Given Taizong's governance, his lingering virtue and remaining influence among the people were not yet distant, yet they nearly came to an end; was the evil not far greater than a single Bao Si could compare to?

sentences.zh: 以太宗之明，昧於知子，廢立之際，不能自決，卒用昏童。

translations.literal: For all Taizong's clarity, he was blind in knowing his sons; at the moment of deposing and installing an heir, he could not decide for himself, and in the end employed a dim-witted child.
translations.idiomatic: For all Taizong's clarity, he failed to know his sons; when the time came to depose one heir and install another, he could not decide for himself, and in the end set up a dull-witted boy.

sentences.zh: 高宗溺愛衽席，不戒履霜之漸，而毒流天下，貽禍邦家。

translations.literal: Gaozong drowned himself in the bedchamber, took no warning from the frost underfoot, and poison spread through the realm, leaving calamity for the state and clan.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong drowned himself in the bedchamber, took no warning from the first trace of frost, and poison spread through the realm, bringing calamity upon the state and the imperial house.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，父子夫婦之間，可謂難哉！

translations.literal: Alas, between father and son, husband and wife—how difficult it is!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—between father and son, husband and wife, how difficult it is!

sentences.zh: 可不慎哉？

translations.literal: How can one not be cautious?
translations.idiomatic: How can one fail to be cautious?
